id: 08_Laboratory Safety for Compressed Gas Cylinders - [Employee Training]
title: 压缩气体钢瓶的安全使用
source_doc: course/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/08_Laboratory Safety for Compressed Gas Cylinders - [Employee Training].md
author_source: project/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/08_Laboratory Safety for Compressed Gas Cylinders - [Employee Training]/src.py

points.K1: 实验室离不开压缩气体
points.K12: 储存：阴凉通风、直立固定、戴帽
points.K14: 可燃与助燃分开，远离火源
points.K22: 绑带优于链条，按规定固定
points.S2: 国内颜色标志与状态牌

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排固定好的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders secured with straps to a wall rack and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲压缩气体钢瓶的安全使用。
overlay: 压缩气体钢瓶的安全使用

shots.scene: 仓库、推车、减压器、警示灯四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a storage cage, a hand truck, a pressure regulator and a warning lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 存得稳、运得好、接得对、漏能管。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一个没固定的气瓶靠在实验台边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans an unsecured gas cylinder against the edge of a lab bench and turns away.
shots.narration: 阿杰图省事，把气瓶往桌边一靠。

shots.scene: 气瓶开始摇晃，被红叉标出
shots.prompt_en: The unsecured cylinder starts to wobble; a red warning outline appears around it. No people.
shots.narration: 一碰就可能倒下来。

shots.scene: 小研扶住气瓶，指向墙上的固定架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steadies the cylinder with both hands and points to a wall rack with straps.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧扶住：先固定，再干活。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 气瓶看着老实，里面却是高压。

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 燃烧器、冷却设备、反应装置三个图标连着气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a burner, a cooling device and a reaction setup, each connected by a line to a gas cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 加热、冷却、做实验，都离不开气体。
overlay: 实验室离不开压缩气体

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 墙上的集中供气管路和一旁的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas supply panel with pipes on one side and a single strapped cylinder on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 有的集中供气，更多还是用气瓶。

shots.scene: 气瓶旁的气体云膨胀到充满整个房间
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon releases a gas cloud that expands to fill a whole room outline. No people.
shots.narration: 一个气瓶，压进了大量气体。

shots.scene: 一个小气瓶与一排大气囊对比
shots.prompt_en: A small cylinder icon next to a row of large gas bags, with an arrow showing they hold the same amount. No people.
shots.narration: 这样就能省下储存空间。

shots.scene: 气瓶剖面，内部箭头向外顶
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a gas cylinder with many arrows pushing outward on the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶内压力很高，气瓶因此很危险。

shots.scene: 四个气瓶图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four cylinder icons in a row, each with a different symbol: a gas cloud, a liquid level, a dissolved dot pattern and a snowflake. No people.
shots.narration: 气体在瓶里，有四种存法。

shots.scene: 气瓶内满是气体小点
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder cutaway filled with tightly packed gas dots. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩气体：压进瓶里，仍是气态。

shots.scene: 气瓶下半部是液体，上方是气体
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder cutaway with liquid in the lower part and gas above it. No people.
shots.narration: 液化气体：加压后变成液体。

shots.scene: 气瓶里填充多孔材料，气体溶在其中
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder cutaway filled with a porous mass and solvent, small gas dots dissolved inside. No people.
shots.narration: 乙炔单独存放不稳定，要溶解储存。

shots.scene: 低温液体罐冒出白雾，旁边雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel cryogenic dewar with a little white vapor at the top and a snowflake icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体：氮、氧、氩冷成液体。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白SDS查看气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a strapped cylinder against a blank safety data sheet in her hand.
shots.narration: 用前先弄清：它怎么存，有何特性。

shots.scene: 可燃、助燃、有毒、窒息四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard icons in a row: a flame, a flame over a circle, a skull, and a person with a breathing warning. No people.
shots.narration: 再想好需要哪些防范措施。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜、面屏和隔热手套站在液氮罐旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside a cryogenic dewar wearing safety goggles, a face shield, long insulated gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 用低温液体，戴护目镜、面屏和隔热手套。

shots.scene: 手背冻伤的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand with frost marks touching a cold pipe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不防护，皮肤会被严重冻伤。

shots.scene: 老李穿安全鞋站在气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in safety shoes and work gloves stands beside a cylinder; a close-up shows the toe-capped shoes.
shots.narration: 气瓶空了也很沉，搬时穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 阀门垫圈结霜出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a frosted valve washer with a crack and a small leak line. No people.
shots.narration: 极低温让垫圈变脆，可能漏气。

shots.scene: 冷冻的钢件受撞击出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a frosted steel part struck by a hammer icon, showing a crack. No people.
shots.narration: 冷的钢件，一撞就可能断裂。

shots.scene: 一小滴液体变成一大团气体
shots.prompt_en: A small drop of cold liquid turns into a huge gas cloud in a room outline. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体一汽化，体积暴增。

shots.scene: 氧气富集的房间里火焰变大
shots.prompt_en: A room outline filled with oxygen-rich air where a small flame icon grows much larger. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气多了，更容易起火爆炸。

shots.scene: 人形图标在缺氧房间里头晕
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram feeling dizzy in a room outline where the air is pushed out by gas. No people.
shots.narration: 别的气体挤走空气，人会窒息。

shots.scene: 倒地的气瓶阀门断裂，气瓶冲出去的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a cylinder lying on the floor with a broken valve and motion lines showing it shooting forward. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶倒地摔坏阀门，会像火箭一样冲出。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比出小心的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up both hands in a careful gesture beside a strapped cylinder.
shots.narration: 所以，搬运气瓶一定要小心。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉通风、直立固定、戴帽
shots.scene: 通风良好的气瓶储存间，气瓶一排固定
shots.prompt_en: A cool dry well-ventilated cylinder storage room with cylinders standing upright and strapped to wall racks. No people.
shots.narration: 储存要阴凉、干燥、通风良好。
overlay: 储存：阴凉通风、直立固定、戴帽

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉通风、直立固定、戴帽
shots.scene: 老李给直立的气瓶系上绑带
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens a strap around an upright cylinder against the wall rack.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立，用绑带固定，防倒防碰。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉通风、直立固定、戴帽
shots.scene: 瓶帽拧在气瓶顶部
shots.prompt_en: A protective valve cap screwed onto the top of a cylinder with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接入系统前，瓶帽一直戴着。

shots.scene: 窗边阳光直射气瓶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder standing in direct sunlight by a window, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要放在阳光直射的地方。

shots.scene: 温度计升高，瓶内箭头变大
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rising next to a cylinder cutaway whose inner pressure arrows grow larger. No people.
shots.narration: 温度升高，瓶内压力也会升高。

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，远离火源
shots.scene: 可燃气瓶和助燃气瓶之间隔着一堵墙
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder and an oxidizing gas cylinder separated by a wall icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体和助燃气体要分开存放。
overlay: 可燃与助燃分开，远离火源

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，远离火源
shots.scene: 气瓶旁的插座火花被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder next to an electrical socket with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 远离带电设备和各种火花。

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，远离火源
shots.scene: 禁止吸烟标志贴在储存间门口
shots.prompt_en: A no smoking sign on the door of a cylinder storage room. No people.
shots.narration: 储存区严禁吸烟。

shots.scene: 气瓶肩部的字样和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a cylinder shoulder with painted stencil stripes and a blank label with a hazard diamond. No people.
shots.narration: 认气瓶，要看字样和标签。

shots.scene: 撕标签的手被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand peeling a label off a cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标签字样，绝不能涂改撕掉。

shots.scene: 只看颜色的问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Three cylinders of different colors with a question mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 只凭颜色猜，靠不住。

shots.scene: 日历图标和腐蚀性象形图的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a cylinder with a corrosive pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀性气体，不宜长期存放。

shots.scene: 易聚合气体的气瓶旁有冰箱图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a blank label next to a refrigerator icon and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 易聚合的气体，期限更要盯紧。

shots.scene: 在地上拖气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person dragging a cylinder across the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在地上拖气瓶。

shots.scene: 手滚气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand rolling a tilted cylinder on its base, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也别斜着手滚，容易滑倒。

shots.scene: 老李用四轮气瓶推车运气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a strapped cylinder on a four-wheel cylinder hand truck along a corridor.
shots.narration: 用气瓶推车最安全，四轮更稳。

shots.scene: 老李把推车推进货梯，自己退出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the cylinder cart into a freight elevator and steps back out.
shots.narration: 跨楼层用货梯，人不要同乘。

shots.scene: 电梯里的人被气体包围的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person inside a small elevator with a leaking cylinder and a gas cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电梯空间小，一漏气无处可逃。

shots.scene: 阿杰在楼上电梯口等候接应
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits at the elevator door on the upper floor to receive the cylinder cart.
shots.narration: 走楼梯去接，或请人在楼上接应。

shots.scene: 推车上的气瓶戴着瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder on a hand truck with its protective cap on and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 运输时，哪怕几步路也戴瓶帽。

shots.scene: 瓶帽挡住撞击的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a capped cylinder valve protected from a bump arrow by the cap. No people.
shots.narration: 倒了碰了，瓶帽能护住阀门。

shots.scene: 伸手去接倒下气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person reaching out to catch a falling cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶倒下，千万别伸手去接。

shots.scene: 小研后退一步让开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps back quickly and keeps her hands away as a cylinder icon tips over in front of her.
shots.narration: 去接的人，受伤反而更多。

shots.scene: 瓶帽、手套、安全鞋三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a cylinder cap, a work glove and a safety shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 戴帽、小心、穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 实验台边的气瓶架和夹具
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder rack with two clamps fixed to the lab bench and the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室都要有气瓶固定装置。

shots.scene: 小研拧紧夹具的蝶形螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the thumb screws of a bench clamp around a cylinder.
shots.narration: 上下两点固定最牢，要卡紧。

shots.scene: 两个气瓶互相碰撞的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two cylinders knocking into each other, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防倒，也防互相碰撞。

shots.section_title: 绑带优于链条，按规定固定
shots.scene: 松垮的链条和收紧的绑带对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a loose chain around a cylinder with a red X, and a tight strap with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 链条容易松，不如绑带牢。
overlay: 绑带优于链条，按规定固定

shots.section_title: 绑带优于链条，按规定固定
shots.scene: 老李把链条拉到最紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls a chain as tight as possible around a cylinder and locks it.
shots.narration: 只能用链条时，要尽量拉紧。

shots.section_title: 绑带优于链条，按规定固定
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白的气瓶管理规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank gas cylinder rule sheet posted on the wall.
shots.narration: 具体要求，按国家和学校规定。

shots.scene: 小研用手拧下瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unscrews the protective cap by hand from a strapped cylinder.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定好，才能拧下瓶帽。

shots.scene: 用螺丝刀撬瓶帽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver prying a cylinder cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用螺丝刀或撬棍硬撬。

shots.scene: 阀门被误打开的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a valve accidentally turning open with gas lines escaping. No people.
shots.narration: 可能误开阀门或把它弄坏。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀口冒出气体线条，旁边警示
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder valve with faint gas lines escaping and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 发现漏气，马上报告。

shots.scene: 锈蚀的气瓶挂上停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A rusty corroded cylinder with a blank do-not-use tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 锈蚀的气瓶也一样停用。

shots.scene: 老周打电话联系供应商
shots.prompt_en: The older man makes a phone call while looking at the tagged cylinder.
shots.narration: 通知负责人和供应商处理。

shots.scene: 减压器特写，两个空白表盘
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a two-gauge pressure regulator with blank dial faces. No people.
shots.narration: 接气先认识减压器。

shots.scene: 高压箭头经过减压器变成低压箭头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a big pressure arrow enters a regulator and comes out as a small arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 它把瓶内高压，降到安全可用。

shots.scene: 几种形状不同的接头图标
shots.prompt_en: Several different valve outlet connector icons with different sizes, notches and thread directions. No people.
shots.narration: 不同气体，接头规格不一样。

shots.scene: 可燃气瓶接到火源附近的系统，出现爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a flammable gas cylinder connected to the wrong line near a flame icon, with a burst icon. No people.
shots.narration: 就是为了防止接错气。

shots.scene: 用扳手硬拧接头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench forcing a connector onto a valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接不上，绝不能硬接。

shots.scene: 小研停下来检查接头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops, looks closely at the connector and the cylinder label, and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 接不上一定有原因，先查清楚。

shots.scene: 瓶阀侧面的泄压装置特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a small pressure relief device on the side of a cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 泄压装置，防止气瓶受热爆裂。

shots.scene: 火焰加热气瓶，泄压口缓慢放气
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cylinder heated by a flame icon, with gas released slowly from the relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 受热时它会打开，有控制地放气。

shots.scene: 可燃气体放出助燃的示意，与爆炸图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a controlled release feeding a small flame, and a cylinder burst crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 虽可能助燃，总好过气瓶爆炸。

shots.scene: 有毒气体气瓶旁的骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a skull pictogram and a valve with no relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒气体气瓶，不设泄压装置。

shots.scene: 管路上的阻火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A flashback arrestor fitted on a gas line between the regulator and the hose. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体常装阻火器。

shots.scene: 火焰沿管路回窜被阻火器挡住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a flame traveling back along a hose and stopped at the flashback arrestor. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住回火，不让火窜进气瓶。

shots.scene: 小研给接头涂检漏液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brushes leak detection liquid onto the regulator connection.
shots.narration: 系统接好后，检查接头和阀门。

shots.scene: 接头处冒出小气泡，旁边警示
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of small bubbles forming at a connection with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 冒泡就说明漏气。

shots.scene: 动画式实验室，气瓶阀门泄漏
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room illustration where a cylinder valve leaks and a gas cloud starts to spread. No people.
shots.narration: 看看氢气瓶阀门漏气会怎样。

shots.scene: 气体越过台面，飘向电器和热源
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud drifts across bench tops toward an electrical device and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 高压推着气体，跑得很远。

shots.scene: 气体遇火花，出现火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud reaches a small spark and a flame icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 遇到火花或明火，就会出事。

shots.scene: 泄漏、扩散、易燃三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a leaking valve, spreading arrows, and a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏、扩散，加上气体本身的危害。

shots.scene: 老周翻开空白应急预案和SDS
shots.prompt_en: The older man opens a blank emergency plan and a blank safety data sheet side by side.
shots.narration: 发现泄漏，按预案和SDS处置。

shots.scene: 小研大声提醒周围的人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand and warns the people around her in the lab.
shots.narration: 马上提醒周围的人。

shots.scene: 平面图上两条疏散路线
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan with two green evacuation route arrows leading to two different exits. No people.
shots.narration: 视情况撤离，熟悉两条疏散路线。

shots.scene: 大家快步走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man walk quickly out of the lab.
shots.narration: 人员撤到安全地方。

shots.scene: 小研在走廊打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call in the corridor outside the lab.
shots.narration: 确认人都安全，再报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起五个手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up five fingers with a cheerful look.
shots.narration: 气瓶事故，大多本可避免。

shots.scene: 五个图标：气体、推车、减压器、接头、警示灯
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a gas cloud, a hand truck, a regulator, a connector and a warning lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 做足功课，用气就不复杂。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白的法规汇编站在气瓶架旁
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank regulations binder beside a cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 气瓶是特种设备，按国家规定管理。

shots.scene: 气瓶上的检验标记旁一个日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a small inspection ring mark and a calendar icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看清检验有效期，超期不用。

shots.scene: 供应商推车送来气瓶，小研核对空白合格证
shots.prompt_en: A delivery cart brings cylinders; the female graduate student checks a blank certificate card.
shots.narration: 从有资质的单位购气，空瓶退回。

shots.scene: 实验室里只放少量气瓶的图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab outline with only two strapped cylinders and a green check, next to a crowded lab with many cylinders crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，气瓶只留够用的。

shots.section_title: 国内颜色标志与状态牌
shots.scene: 几种不同颜色的气瓶，带空白字样区
shots.prompt_en: Several cylinders in different standard colors, each with a blank stencil band. No people.
shots.narration: 国内气瓶颜色有国家标准。
overlay: 国内颜色标志与状态牌

shots.section_title: 国内颜色标志与状态牌
shots.scene: 气瓶上挂着三种空白状态牌
shots.prompt_en: Three cylinders each with a blank status tag in green, yellow and grey. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色只作辅助，认准字样标签。

shots.section_title: 国内颜色标志与状态牌
shots.scene: 空瓶与满瓶分区存放
shots.prompt_en: Full cylinders and empty cylinders stored in two separate marked areas. No people.
shots.narration: 满瓶空瓶分开，挂好状态牌。

shots.scene: 墙上的气体报警器亮起
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas detector with a flashing light and a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 用可燃、有毒气体，要装报警器。

shots.scene: 液氮罐旁的氧含量报警器
shots.prompt_en: A cryogenic dewar in a small room with an oxygen monitor on the wall and an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 用低温液体的房间，要监测氧含量。

shots.scene: 气瓶柜内有排风管
shots.prompt_en: A ventilated gas cabinet with an exhaust duct on top holding one cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 保持通风，危险气体放进气瓶柜。

shots.scene: 带骷髅象形图的气瓶放在上锁气瓶柜里
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a skull pictogram inside a locked ventilated gas cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒气体，按危险化学品从严管理。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周在空白领用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man both sign a blank control logbook.
shots.narration: 专人管理、登记使用。

shots.scene: 小研顺时针关紧瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve by hand after finishing her experiment.
shots.narration: 用完立刻关紧瓶阀。

shots.scene: 压力表指针停在低位但不归零
shots.prompt_en: A blank pressure gauge with the needle low but not at zero, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里的气不能用尽，要留余压。

shots.scene: 开阀时人站在侧面
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a person standing to the side of a regulator, not in front of it, opening the valve slowly. No people.
shots.narration: 开阀站侧面，缓慢开启。

shots.scene: 油污手套接触氧气瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oily glove touching an oxygen cylinder valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气瓶和减压器，严禁沾油。

shots.scene: 开关电灯的图标被打叉，旁边打开的窗
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand flipping a light switch crossed out with a red X, next to an open window icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体泄漏，不开关电器，开窗通风。

shots.scene: 小研关闭瓶阀后离开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve and then leaves the room.
shots.narration: 确保安全时关阀，不安全就撤。

shots.scene: 电话图标和119、120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 起火打119，有人受伤打120。

shots.scene: 报告链条：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 并报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现绑带固定的气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a strapped cylinder and a valve cap.
shots.narration: 直立固定，戴好瓶帽。

shots.scene: 推车和电梯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cylinder hand truck and a freight elevator with a no-rider symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 推车搬运，人瓶不同梯。

shots.scene: 可燃与助燃之间的隔墙图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flammable cylinder and an oxidizing cylinder separated by a wall, with a no smoking sign. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃助燃分开，远离火源。

shots.scene: 减压器、接头、气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a regulator, a matching connector and small leak test bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 接头专用不硬接，接好就检漏。

shots.scene: 报警器、疏散箭头和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas detector, an evacuation arrow and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 漏气先示警，撤离再报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐固定的气瓶架旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy cylinder rack with all cylinders strapped and capped.
shots.narration: 气瓶管得住，实验才安心，下次见！
